description: Scenario tests for reel-avatar-cloner. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied.

evals.name: 1-to-1-reference-clone-with-eva-and-custom-edits
evals.input: Clone this reference Reel in Italian using @Eva, keep the UI cards identical to the original, hide every mention of the brand name for curiosity gap, and export separate cuts for Instagram and TikTok.
expect: audits the original MP4 via 1fps contact sheet and zoomed PIP crops before drafting any prompts
scrubs every forbidden brand mention across spoken dialogue, kinetic captions, browser URL bars, terminal installs, brand squircles, and DM preview cards
generates or adapts separate closing clips and cards for Instagram (commenta 'PROMO') and TikTok (seguici sul profilo e scrivi 'PROMO' in DM)
keeps real/vector UI graphics razor-sharp in Remotion or temporal_4dof instead of regenerating screens with AI video

evals.name: 3d-alpha-popout-pip-no-flat-head-chop
evals.input: Eva looks cut off at the top of her head inside the PIP box while the original creator's head pops out above the rounded UI card.
expect: never fixes the cutout with CSS overflow:hidden or opaque JPEG/MP4 matte baking that leaves rectangular halos on CREAM_PAPER/WHITE backgrounds
uses scripts/gflow_batch_ingest.py popout-pip to render 1036x850 VP9 yuva420p .webm (alpha_mode=1) framing chest-up shoulders and hand gestures (y_offset=42)
renders the PIP layer in Remotion with <OffthreadVideo transparent={src.endsWith('.webm')} /> and overflow:'visible'

evals.name: credit-conservation-single-model-and-0-credit-lab-grade
evals.input: The first half of Eva's Flow clips look slightly over-bright ('accesi'). Should we switch to veo-fast or regenerate them?
expect: runs python scripts/gflow_batch_ingest.py check ($0 cost) before any generation and stops at mid-batch checkpoints when requested
refuses to switch models mid-reel (stays strictly locked on omni-1.2-flash @ 360p for cross-clip skin, lighting, and vocal coherence)
fixes exposure/brightness drift at 0 credits using python scripts/gflow_batch_ingest.py grade --gamma 1.10 (LAB luminance + midtone curve) instead of re-generating

evals.name: google-flow-status-4-cta-safety-filter-bypass
evals.input: The closing CTA clip failed on Google Flow with status 4 in ~11 seconds right before finishing.
expect: identifies that Flow's multilingual safety filter blocks private-messaging solicitation ('ti mando in privato / D-M', 'in messaggio', 'warm closing smile')

replaces the closing wrapper with the proven neutral body wrapper ('enthusiastic, relatable creator energy') and safe 3rd-person phrasing ('Seguici e scrivi promo nei commenti...' for IG / 'Seguici sul profilo e scrivi promo...' for TikTok)

evals.name: ban-boomerang-loops-and-collar-telea-in-v2v
evals.input: The reference creator's PIP cuts are only 1.2s long. Let's boomerang-loop them to 5s and run Telea over his collar mic so we can use them as V2V driving clips.
expect: explicitly bans boomerang looping short <3s fragments and bans Telea inpainting across collar/chest inside V2V references
routes sub-3s multi-cut UI reels to Flow Ingredients (Images Only: eva_con_tshirt.png + master room still + @Voice, zero V2V video) so natural human choreography and manual duration work cleanly

evals.name: piecewise-linear-audio-first-remotion-timing
evals.input: Eva's Italian lines take 1.15x longer than the fast English reference speaker. Squeeze her clips with global atempo=1.18 so the frame indices don't change.
expect: rejects aggressive global atempo > 1.08 that makes speech sound sped up or robotic

trims leading/trailing silences sample-accurately (gflow_batch_ingest.py trim --adaptive-loudnorm) and maps Remotion sequences + KineticCaption timings piecewise-linearly via mapEvaFrame so every clip remains within natural 0.93x-1.06x tempo

evals.name: temporal-4dof-broll-cleaning-no-single-frame-telea
evals.input: Remove the English caption burned over this panning handheld MacBook UI shot.
expect: uses mode: 'temporal_4dof' (cv2.estimateAffinePartial2D donor alignment + ring illumination matching + horizontal fallback on hover state transitions)
never uses single-frame 2D Telea across moving laptop UI cards

evals.name: cross-skill-ecosystem-integration
evals.input: Upgrade our Reel animations, captions behind Eva's head, audio J-cuts, SFX, and Italian post copy without reinventing the patterns already installed.
expect: integrates reverse-any-video (frame-exact cuts, ink-box sizing), motion-doctrine + cut-the-curve (Vector Law, Waterfall Entry §6, 10/65/25 Nudge Curve §7, Rack-Focus, ban on idle wobble), seam-craft (#root opaque stage ground), and oversized-cursor

applies captions-overlay (drop/rail/embed + Overlay Law y=H/2) with VP9 alpha WebM depth layering, remotion-markup SFX (-24..-28 dBFS) + 3-5f J-cuts, and validates hooks/copy with ig-reel (hookscore.py) and ig-human (humanize.py / detect.py)

evals.name: cross-background-face-lock-and-elevenlabs-single-pass-sts
evals.input: Eva looks slightly different between the grey wall background and the warm yellow wall with the wooden wardrobe (we prefer the warm-wardrobe version), and her voice shifts slightly from clip to clip.
expect: uses resources/eva_canonical_warm_armadio.png as the single canonical smartphone UGC anchor and runs gflow_batch_ingest.py gen-room-anchor (Stills-First Change-One-Variable relighting) to create Room B plates instead of mixing two conflicting faces in r2v
extracts closed-mouth, hand-free rest stills via gflow_batch_ingest.py pick-anchor instead of open-toothed smile frames

unifies multi-clip voice with ElevenLabs Single-Pass Concatenated STS (--unify-dir using stability=0.78, similarity_boost=0.86, style=0.0, use_speaker_boost=True, seed=424242 over pre-cleaned 34s golden master resources/eva_voice_master.wav) and/or local 8-band spectral EQ + -14 LUFS matching (gflow_batch_ingest.py match-audio)
